rules.title: Ban on sale or use of algorithmic rent-setting devices
rules.requirement: Prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices (e.g., software analyzing nonpublic competitor rental data to recommend rents for vacant units) to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco. Tenants or the City Attorney may bring a civil action for violations.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential units in San Francisco; applies to entities selling or using algorithmic devices that analyze nonpublic competitor rental data.
rules.penalty: Civil action by a tenant or the City Attorney
rules.quoted_span: adding Section 37.10C to the Rent Ordinance went into effect on October 14, 2024. The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
